content.title: Scholarship apply?
content.subtitle: Scholarship ka process bhi admission jitna dhyaan maangta hai.

steps.title: Eligibility padho
steps.detail: Country, course, marks ya background. Jo fit nahi, usme time mat lagao.

steps.title: Deadlines alag likho
steps.detail: Scholarship ki deadline admission se alag ho sakti hai. Dono ki alag list banao.

steps.title: Documents ready rakho
steps.detail: Transcripts, resume, recommendation, aur kabhi kabhi income proof. Pehle se scan kar lo.

steps.title: Essay khud likho
steps.detail: Apni kahani, apne shabdon mein. Template wala essay sab jagah ek jaisa lagta hai.

steps.title: Zyada jagah apply karo
steps.detail: Chhoti scholarships bhi kaam ki hain. Kai milkar bada farak laati hain.
steps.tip: Scholarship Finder pe country aur level se filter karo.

caption:
Scholarship ke liye apply kar rahe ho? Ye 5 steps miss mat karna 👇

1. Eligibility padho
2. Deadlines alag likho
3. Documents ready
4. Essay khud likho
5. Zyada jagah apply karo

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jise iski zaroorat hai.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
